description: This file defines a set of table-related commands for a ProseMirror-based editor, including functions for manipulating table structure such as adding/removing rows and columns, merging/splitting cells, toggling headers, and navigating between cells.

methods.name: selectedRect
methods.description: Returns the rectangle area of the current cell selection in a table, including table metadata for further operations.

methods.name: addColumn
methods.description: Adds a new column at a specified position in a table, adjusting colspans as needed.

methods.name: addColumnBefore
methods.description: Command to insert a column before the currently selected column.

methods.name: addColumnAfter
methods.description: Command to insert a column after the currently selected column.

methods.name: removeColumn
methods.description: Removes a specified column from a table, adjusting colspans accordingly.

methods.name: deleteColumn
methods.description: Deletes the currently selected columns in a table.

methods.name: rowIsHeader
methods.description: Checks if a given row in a table is composed entirely of header cells.

methods.name: addRow
methods.description: Adds a new row at a specified position in a table, considering row spans.

methods.name: addRowBefore
methods.description: Command to insert a row before the current selection.

methods.name: addRowAfter
methods.description: Command to insert a row after the current selection.

methods.name: removeRow
methods.description: Removes a specified row from a table, adjusting rowspans.

methods.name: deleteRow
methods.description: Deletes the currently selected rows in a table.

methods.name: mergeCells
methods.description: Merges selected cells into a single cell if they form a rectangle.

methods.name: splitCell
methods.description: Splits a cell with rowspan or colspan greater than one into smaller cells.

methods.name: splitCellWithType
methods.description: Splits a cell into smaller cells with specific cell types (e.g., header or normal).

methods.name: setCellAttr
methods.description: Returns a command to set a specific attribute for selected cells if not already set.

methods.name: toggleHeader
methods.description: Toggles header cells in a row or column, with deprecated logic option.

methods.name: toggleHeaderRow
methods.description: Toggles whether the selected row contains header cells.

methods.name: toggleHeaderColumn
methods.description: Toggles whether the selected column contains header cells.

methods.name: toggleHeaderCell
methods.description: Toggles whether the selected cells are header cells.

methods.name: findNextCell
methods.description: Finds the position of the next or previous cell in a table for navigation.

methods.name: goToNextCell
methods.description: Returns a command to move the selection to the next or previous cell.

methods.name: deleteTable
methods.description: Deletes the entire table around the current selection.

methods.name: deleteCellSelection
methods.description: Clears the content of selected cells if they are not empty.

methods.name: moveTableRow
methods.description: Moves a table row from one index to another.

methods.name: moveTableColumn
methods.description: Moves a table column from one index to another.
